name: Boler Consolidated Journal Entry
description: Monthly consolidated JE with per-division splits, GL codes, balance check, and CFO sign-off attestation.

bdaSchema.description: The monthly benefits JE — must balance to the penny, must split across all 5 divisions with correct GL codes, must carry the two-stage approval chain (Benefits Manager + CFO).
bdaSchema.extractionInstructions: Debits must equal credits. Per-division splits must sum to the consolidated total. Every GL code must exist in the company chart-of-accounts. Approval chain must be complete before status can be POSTED.

line_items.description: Per-line — { gl_code, description, debit, credit, division_code }

exception_links.description: Resolved exceptions reflected in this JE

status.description: DRAFT / PENDING_BENEFITS / PENDING_CFO / APPROVED / POSTED / DISTRIBUTED
